title: MenuItem
description: A single transcribed line item positioned on a MenuPage in the NYPL 'What's on the Menu?' dataset. A MenuItem links a Dish to a specific MenuPage, capturing the price and the (x, y) location of the transcription on the page image. Corresponds to a row in MenuItem.csv.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the menu item (transcription instance).

menu_page_id.description: Foreign key to the MenuPage.id on which this item was transcribed.

dish_id.description: Foreign key to the Dish.id this item names. May be null when a transcription has not yet been linked to a normalized dish.

price.description: Transcribed price of the dish as it appeared on the menu, in the menu's currency. Decimal with up to 3 places.

high_price.description: Upper bound of a price range when the menu listed a range rather than a single price.

xpos.description: Normalized horizontal position (0..1) of the transcription on the page image, relative to MenuPage.full_width.

ypos.description: Normalized vertical position (0..1) of the transcription on the page image, relative to MenuPage.full_height.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the transcription record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the transcription record was last updated.
